post.description:
**Protocols:** Linked Device API · Meta Cloud API

**Required scope:** `messages:write`

Send a message to a conversation. Put exactly one message kind inside content. Testing sessions send only to active testing numbers in the same project; supply the recipient phoneNumber.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key, 1 to 255 bytes of UTF-8, that makes this write safe to retry for 24 hours. A retry with the same key, credential, `Polymorfa-Version`, and request never runs the write again: it returns `409 idempotency_completed` when the original succeeded, or the original server error, with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Reusing the key for a different request returns `409 idempotency_conflict`; a retry while the original is still running returns `409 idempotency_in_progress`, and a retry after an unrecorded outcome returns `409 idempotency_outcome_unknown`.

202.description: Accepted for asynchronous processing in response to `Prefer: respond-async`; the result is not included

402.description: `billing_credit_required`: credit is unavailable for this number. Add credit or review team billing.

error.message: Credit is unavailable for this number. Add credit or review team billing.

409.description: `unsupported_for_connection`: call permission requests need a Cloud API number; `call_permission_granted`: the person already granted permanent permission. The Idempotency-Key already succeeded (`idempotency_completed`), was used for a different request (`idempotency_conflict`), belongs to a request that is still running (`idempotency_in_progress`, with Retry-After), or belongs to a request whose outcome was not recorded (`idempotency_outcome_unknown`)

error.message: The session's connection does not support this call operation.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when this response reports the recorded outcome of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

422.description: The supplied media URL could not be fetched

429.description: `call_permission_request_limited`: WhatsApp limits how often this person can be asked for call permission.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the limiting window resets, when WhatsApp reports a reset time.

Polymorfa-RateLimit-Reason.description: The limit that blocked the request.

error.message: WhatsApp limits how often this number can ask this person for call permission. Follow Retry-After when supplied.

501.description: `operation_not_supported`: the number's connection cannot send this content, such as a poll, or a URL, call or copy-code button on an official WhatsApp Business number

list.description: On an official WhatsApp Business number, `title` is the header (at most 60 characters) and `description` the body (at most 1,024 characters); without `description`, `title` is the body. There, each section title allows at most 24 characters and is required when the list has more than one section, lists allow at most 10 rows in total, row titles at most 24 characters, row IDs at most 200, row descriptions at most 72, `buttonText` at most 20 and `footer` at most 60. Every number also limits `buttonText` to 64 UTF-8 bytes, row `id` to 256 bytes and `title` and `description` to 256 and 4,096 bytes, so multibyte text reaches those byte limits before the character limits. Content outside any limit returns `400`.

buttons.description: On an official WhatsApp Business number, only `reply` buttons are sent; other button types return `501`. There, `body` allows at most 1,024 characters, `title` and `footer` at most 60, and each button needs a unique `id` and a unique `text` of at most 20 characters. Every number also limits each button `id` to 256 UTF-8 bytes. Content outside any limit returns `400`.

body.description: Why you want to call, shown above WhatsApp's allow and decline buttons. 1 to 1,024 Unicode characters.

callPermissionRequest.description: Ask the person for permission to call them. Cloud API numbers only; WhatsApp limits how often you can ask.

reason.description: Why the session was logged out: `banned` when WhatsApp banned the account, `device_removed` when the linked device was removed from the phone or from another device, `unknown` otherwise (including a locked account).

code.description: WhatsApp's logout code: 401 (removed), 403 (locked) or 406 (banned); 0 when WhatsApp gave none.

durationSeconds.description: Total connected duration in seconds (0 if never answered).

reason.description: Termination reason: user_hangup | timeout | lost_connection | rejected | capacity | pod_lost | connection_failed | upstream_failed | call_restricted (WhatsApp refused the call because the number is restricted to calling people it has already chatted with).

sessionConnection.description: Connection of the session that carries the call: a linked device or the WhatsApp Business Cloud API.

BearerAuth.description: Polymorfa team key (pmfa_ prefix), project token (pmfa_pt_ prefix) where supported, or short-lived client token (pmfa_ct_ prefix). Team keys and project tokens may be personal or service-account owned and enforce selected action scopes. Team keys cover the team and its projects; project tokens stay inside one project. Client tokens stay inside their live project and session and enforce their client rules and immutable mint-time action ceiling. Treat all credentials as opaque strings. Never parse them or assume a fixed length; store at least 512 characters. Server keys use issuance-record lookup; short-lived client tokens carry a signed permission ceiling.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Team request quota per rolling minute, when the per-team request limiter applies.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the per-team quota; zero when this limiter rejects the request.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the oldest counted request leaves the rolling window, when the per-team request limiter applies. Follow Retry-After on a rejected request.
